Shephalika                             Business Analyst – Banking & Finance

Career Aspiration:  
Results-driven Business Analyst with 6 years of experience  in the Banking, Lending, and Insurance (BFSI)  
domain, specializing in Digital Transformation initiatives across Retail Banking, Onboarding journeys, Wealth 
Management, Cards, lending, and Insurance products. Experienced in collaborating with cross -functional 
stakeholders to elicit, analyse, and document business requirements, translating them into impactful 
technology solutions. Proficient in both Agile (Scrum)  and Waterfall SDLC methodologies, with strong 
expertise in requirements elicitation, business analysis, stakeholder management, business process 
improvement, and functional documentation . Seeking a challenging opportunity as a Business Analyst  or 
Product Owner  with an IT services company, bank, insurance organization, or fintech firm, where I can 
leverage my domain expertise in BFSI products, digital platforms, and process optimization to deliver 
innovative solutions and contribute to organizational growth and business success. 
Professional Summary: 
• Experienced Business Analyst  in delivering Digital Transformation initiatives across the Banking, Cards, 
Lending, and Wealth Management, Insurance (BFSI) domain in Agile (Scrum) and Waterfall methodologies. 
• Strong domain expertise in Retail Banking, Digital Banking, Internet Banking, Cards & Payments, Loan 
Origination (LOS), Loan Servicing, Wealth Management, Insurance Policy Administration, Risk & Compliance, 
and customer-centric digital solutions. 
• Sound understanding of banking, lending, and insurance products, Core Banking Systems (CBS), CRM, 
regulatory compliance, and end-to-end digital customer journeys. 
• Proven ability to bridge business needs with technology solutions by collaborating with business 
stakeholders and cross-functional teams to deliver value-driven outcomes. 
• Hands-on experience across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), from requirement elicitation and 
analysis to solution delivery, testing, deployment, and production support. 
• Proficient in preparing BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Use Cases, Process Flow Diagrams, 
Functional Specifications, RTMs, and Wireframes. 
• Experienced in facilitating requirement workshops, backlog refinement, sprint planning, functional 
walkthroughs, and knowledge transfer sessions, ensuring seamless collaboration between business and 
technology teams. 
• Partnered with UI/UX Designers, Solution Architects, Developers, and QA teams to design, develop, test, and 
implement business solutions that align with organizational objectives. 
• Supported test planning, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect management, release validation, and post-
production support to ensure successful project delivery. 
• Led Target Operating Model (TOM) initiatives by assessing current-state operating models, defining future-
state operating models, and supporting enterprise -wide business transformation across Retail Banking, 
Cards, Payments, Lending, and Wealth Management.  
• Designed and implemented Operating Models by defining business capabilities, process architecture, 
governance models, customer journeys, and service delivery frameworks aligned with business strategy.  
• Drove Operating Model Transformation by conducting current -state assessments, identifying capability 
gaps, defining target-state processes, and supporting digital transformation initiatives.  
• Contributed to Business Architecture  by developing Business Capability Maps, Process Architecture, 
Customer Journey Maps, and Business Process Models to align business strategy with technology solutions.  
• Performed Business Capability Assessment and Business Capability Mapping to identify capability gaps, 
prioritize transformation initiatives, and define target-state business capabilities.  
• Conducted Value Stream Mapping to analyze end-to-end banking processes, eliminate process bottlenecks, 
improve Straight Through Processing (STP), and enhance customer experience across Cards, Payments, 
Digital Banking, and Wealth Management.  
• Designed and documented AS-IS and TO-BE Process Flows, Process Architecture, Business Process Models, 
and BPMN workflows to support enterprise transformation and operating model improvements.  
• Led Business Process Re -engineering (BPR), Process Assessments, GAP Analysis, and Process Optimization 
initiatives to improve operational efficiency and business performance.  
• Facilitated cross-functional Business Architecture, TOM, Process Design, and Customer Journey workshops 
with Business, Operations, Product Owners, Enterprise Architects, Technology, Risk, and Compliance 
stakeholders.  
• Defined end -to-end Customer Journeys  and future -state business processes across Digital Onboarding, 
Credit Card Origination, Account Servicing, Loan Origination, Payments, and Wealth Management.  
• Partnered with Product Owners, Enterprise Architects, Solution Architects, and Technology teams to 
translate business strategy, operating models, and business capabilities into detailed business requirements, 
functional specifications, and implementation roadmaps.  
• Supported large -scale Business Transformation, Enterprise Transformation, and Digital Transformation 
programs by aligning business capabilities, operating models, customer journeys, and process architecture 
with organizational objectives. 
• Proficient in Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Visio, Draw.io, Balsamiq, and Microsoft Office Suite for requirements 
management, process modelling, collaboration, and project documentation. 
• Strong analytical, stakeholder management, presentation, negotiation, and problem -solving skills, with a 
demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and deliver measurable business outcomes. 
Educational Qualification & Certifications: 
• Agile Business Analyst, IT Business Analyst Certifications from Simplilearn. 
• Post Graduate Diploma in Management in Finance & Marketing from IIM, Pune in 2015. 
• Bachelor of Commerce from St Xavier's College, Ranchi in 2013.

Professional Experience: 
1) Deutsche Bank- Senior Business Analyst (Duration: Aug 2020 to till now). 
Senior Business Analyst – End to End Digitalization of Credit Card Issuance (Card Origination), Card Servicing 
functionalities, Enhancement and optimization of Features in Digital Banking Initiatives like Account 
Servicing, Deposits Enrichment, Cards Servicing, Loans Servicing, Policy Servicing – Straight Through 
Processing (STP) Journeys . Digital Lending – Digitalization of retail loan journeys (Loan Origination System) , 
Policy Origination & Policy administration services for Insurance products. 
Wealth Management – Customer Onboarding Journeys ISA A/c (Investment Services A/c), Servicing journeys. 
 
Key Roles & Responsibilities: 
• Acted as a strategic liaison between Business Stakeholders, Product Owners, IT Development, QA, and 
Vendor teams, ensuring seamless collaboration and alignment throughout the Software Development Life 
Cycle (SDLC) using both Agile (Scrum) and Waterfall methodologies. 
• Partnered with cross -functional business stakeholders to elicit, analyze, validate, and prioritize business 
requirements, translating them into well-defined Epics, User Stories, and Acceptance Criteria using Jira. 
• Produced comprehensive business and functional documentation including Business Requirement 
Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), User Stories, Use Cases, Requirement 
Traceability Matrix (RTM), Process Flows, and Functional Specifications. 
• Leveraged Jira and Confluence to manage product backlogs, maintain project documentation, track 
requirement traceability, and facilitate collaboration across business and technology teams. 
• Conducted stakeholder workshops, requirement elicitation sessions, and business process assessments to 
identify opportunities for process optimization, automation, and digital transformation across Retail Banking 
and Digital Banking platforms. 
• Performed GAP Analysis and documented AS-IS and TO-BE business processes using process flow diagrams 
and wireframes, enabling stakeholders to visualize solution design and future-state processes. 
• Collaborated closely with Solution Architects, Development, QA, and Vendor teams to clarify functional 
requirements, resolve business queries, and ensure successful delivery of business solutions. 
• Facilitated knowledge transfer (KT) sessions and walkthroughs of business requirements, functional 
specifications, and user stories for Development and Quality Assurance teams to ensure a common 
understanding of project objectives. 
• Owned and continuously refined the Product Backlog by prioritizing user stories, managing change requests, 
and supporting release planning in collaboration with Product Owners and business stakeholders. 
• Actively participated in Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand -ups, Backlog Refinement, 
Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives to ensure timely delivery and continuous improvement. 
• Provided regular project status updates to business stakeholders and senior management, highlighting risks, 
dependencies, issue resolution, release readiness, and change request progress. 
• Coordinated User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by preparing test scenarios, reviewing test cases, supporting 
business users during execution, managing defect resolution, and obtaining business sign -off prior to 
production deployment. 
• Supported successful implementation and post -production validation of new features and enhancements 
by collaborating with business users, technology teams, and support teams to ensure smooth business 
adoption. 
2) Deutsche Bank – Private Banking Relationship Manager (Duration: Apr 2019 to Jul 2020). 
Private Banking Relationship Manager – Managed a portfolio of HNI/UHNI clients by delivering personalized 
wealth management, investment advisory, portfolio optimization, and financial planning solutions, client 
retention, and revenue generation. 
Key Roles & Responsibilities: 
• Advised clients on diversified investment and wealth management products including Mutual Funds, 
Equities, Bonds, Structured Products, Insurance, Fixed Income Securities, and Retirement Planning solutions 
based on their risk profile and investment horizon. 
• Conducted periodic portfolio reviews, investment performance analysis, and financial planning discussions 
to optimize portfolio allocation, strengthen client engagement, and improve client retention. 
• Managed end-to-end execution of high-value investment transactions while ensuring operational accuracy, 
timely processing, and an exceptional client experience. 
• Ensured strict adherence to regulatory and compliance frameworks by maintaining high standards in KYC, 
AML, FATCA, investment suitability assessments, documentation, and internal audit requirements. 
• Collaborated with Investment Advisors, Treasury, Credit, Product, Operations, and Compliance teams to 
design integrated financial solutions that addressed clients' investment, lending, insurance, and wealth 
preservation needs. 
• Leveraged client feedback and service analytics to identify process improvement opportunities, enhancing 
service quality, operational efficiency, client satisfaction, and Net Promoter Score (NPS). 
• Monitored market trends, economic developments, and regulatory changes to provide timely investment 
insights and proactive portfolio recommendations, enabling clients to make informed financial decisions. 
• Consistently delivered superior client experience by combining relationship management expertise, financial 
advisory capabilities, and operational excellence to drive long-term client loyalty and business growth. 
Previous Work Experience: 
• Worked as Wealth Manager at Globe Capital Ltd during Jan 2018 to Apr 2019. 
• Worked as Senior Relationship Manager at ICICI Securities during July 2015 to Oct 2017.
